newsitem.title: JORDAN: French foreign minister, Jordan PM discuss Mideast.
newsitem.headline: French foreign minister, Jordan PM discuss Mideast.

text.p: French Foreign Minister Herve de Charette held talks on Wednesday with Jordanian Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti about Middle East peace negotiations, the official Petra News Agency reported.
It said de Charette arrived in Jordan from Cairo on his way to the West Bank town of Ramallah, where French President Jacques Chirac was to address the Palestinian legislative council.

De Charette and Kabariti discussed Palestinian-Israeli talks on a long-delayed Israeli troop redeployment in the West Bank town of Hebron and France's "prominent and influential role" in the peace process, Petra said.
Chirac, due in Jordan later on Wednesday, has sought greater European influence in the U.S.-brokered Middle East peace process where Arabs believe Washington favours Israel.
